label: PF Backlog 3
title: WG-O3: Canonical repo + git worktree session model; API-only backlog writes (guarded, allow checkpoint/delivery)
body: Part of EPIC BI-PF-0360. Source: docs/WORKER-SCHEDULER-OPERATIONS.md.

brief.problem: independent clones each carry a backlog copy -> divergence and dirty trees.
brief.what_adds: One canonical checkout + a worktree per session; a guard that flags backlog file edits made outside the API/checkpoint path.
brief.why: Removes clone divergence; parallel sessions stop fighting over backlog files.

objective: Standardize on one canonical repo + worktrees, and route backlog writes through the API.
acceptance_criteria: Documented session model: one canonical checkout, git worktree per session (IS-PF-0036).
A guard flags direct backlog-file edits made outside the API/checkpoint/delivery path (advisory first; baseline-aware).
Checkpoint + delivery bookkeeping commits remain allowed.
approach: Adopt worktrees; add an advisory baseline-aware guard; never blanket-block backlog commits.
verification: guard flags an out-of-band edit; checkpoint/delivery commits pass.
risks: false positives on legitimate commits (mitigated: advisory + allowlist).

analysis.implementation_strategy: Canonical repo + git worktree per session extending core/backlog.py; enforce API-only backlog writes by guarding direct file writes and routing through /api/v1/backlog/items and /api/v1/backlog/ids:reserve with checkpoint/delivery allowlist.
dependency_findings: No hard deps; RELATED to BI-PF-1329 lease semantics and BI-PF-1326 fetch wrapper
conflict_findings: Overlaps start APIs with BI-PF-1326 - define boundary (1326 calls into 1327 session model)
Write guards touch backlog endpoints also used by BI-PF-1329
duplication_findings: Backlog API surface (/api/v1/backlog/*) already exists - reuse rather than build new write path
No existing worktree session model component found - minimal new session helper may be needed
analysis.rationale: Extends existing backlog API layer; worktree session helper is additive, not a rewrite.
assumptions: Canonical repo already designated or trivially identifiable
Existing backlog APIs cover checkpoint/delivery writes
risks: Guard bypass if any code path still writes backlog files directly
Concurrency between worktrees and merge drivers (BI-PF-1328)
evidence: Candidate modules include model-catalog/policy configs used for guard policy
missing_info: Which write paths count as checkpoint/delivery allowlist

context_review.reason: Existing backlog API and core/backlog.py provide clear extension points.
